subject: Culture
title: Ancestor Worship and Legacy
description: A 60-second lesson on Ancestor Worship and Legacy.

hook.text: In rural China families spend more on a grandfather's tomb than on a child's school fees.

buildup.text: Ancestor veneration assumes the dead watch over the living. Disrespecting them invites misfortune.

discovery.text: This belief system turned every descendant into a guardian of family reputation across generations.

twist.text: Confucius never called it religion. He called it filial duty—the foundation of all social order.

climax.text: Modern Chinese entrepreneurs still consult ancestral tablets before major business decisions.

punchline.text: The dead still vote in family meetings.

quiz.question: What did Confucius call the duty to honor ancestors?
